lines.en: label day56:
scene mayaoffice0
And so begins another lonely day in the office.
lines.zh: 于是，办公室里又一个孤独的日子开始了。

lines.en: Upon thinking more about it, this whole ‘guidance counselor’ thing doesn’t really make sense to me, to be honest.
lines.zh: 仔细想想，说实话，这个「心理辅导员」的身份对我来说根本说不通。

lines.en: Most days, I just find myself sitting here for an hour or two before calling it quits and going home.
lines.zh: 大多数日子里，我只是坐上一两个小时，然后就算了，回家去。

lines.en: Sure, there are rare occasions where someone will actually stop by...but I think only {i}one{/i} of those occasions has actually involved counseling so far.
lines.zh: 当然，偶尔也会有人真的来访……但我觉得到目前为止，真正算得上咨询的大概只有{i}一{/i}次。

lines.en: Two, maybe- if you count being blown off by Yumi as counseling. Which I do not.
lines.zh: 两次吧，也许——如果把被 Yumi 甩脸子也算作咨询的话。我可不这么算。

lines.en: Welp, it looks like someone else is here to take advantage of both my office hours and a position I am absolutely not qualified for.
lines.zh: 好吧，看来又有人来了，要来占用我的办公时间，以及这个我绝对不够格的职位。

lines.en: : Come in.
lines.zh: : 请进。

lines.en: show mayaoffice1
And...it looks like it's someone entirely unexpected.
lines.zh: 而且……来的似乎是个完全出乎意料的人。

lines.en: : Huh...
: What do you mean “Huh?” Am I not allowed to use this office for the same unintended purposes everyone else uses it for?
lines.zh: : 「咦」是什么意思？难道我不像其他人一样，可以把这间办公室挪作他用吗？

lines.en: : That depends on whether or not you are here for a shoulder massage.
lines.zh: : 那得看你是不是来要肩部按摩的。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice1r
: What? Ew. No.
lines.zh: : 什么？恶心。不是。

lines.en: : Is that seriously what you've been using this place for?
lines.zh: : 你一直都在拿这地方干这种事？

lines.en: : You're disgusting...
lines.zh: : 你真恶心……

lines.en: : So, what brings you here today, Maya?
lines.zh: : 那么，今天是什么风把你吹来了，Maya？

lines.en: : It’s not often you actually come to see me. In fact, I’m pretty sure that this is the first time this has ever happened.
lines.zh: : 你主动来找我可不常见。事实上，我敢说这是有史以来第一次。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice1
: That is correct. And don't take my arrival here as some sort of omen for things to come. I would like to clarify first and foremost that I absolutely do not want to be here right now.
lines.zh: : 没错。另外，别把我的到来当成什么预兆。我首先要澄清一点：我现在是绝对不想待在这儿的。

lines.en: : Well, that's a good start to this conversation.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这对话开头不错。

lines.en: : The fact of the matter is, if I {i}didn’t{/i} remind you of something soon, horrible things would likely follow.
lines.zh: : 事实是，如果我{i}不{/i}尽快提醒你某件事，很可能会有可怕的事情接踵而至。

lines.en: : That’s...ominous.
lines.zh: : 这……听起来不祥啊。

lines.en: : What is truly ominous is your existence and all of the horrible things that occur because of it.
lines.zh: : 真正不祥的是你的存在，以及因它而发生的一切可怕的事。

lines.en: : So, how is this new world treating you?
lines.zh: : 那么，这个新世界待你如何？

lines.en: : You mean the world that I have been in forever?
lines.zh: : 你是说我一直在的那个世界？

lines.en: : No. I mean the one that you continuously deny that you’ve been reborn into even though we both know that is not the case.
lines.zh: : 不。我指的是那个你一直否认自己转生进去的世界，尽管我们俩都知道事实并非如此。

lines.en: : I'm just going to assume you mean the world I've been in forever- which has been pretty good so far, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我就当你指的是我一直待着的那个世界吧——到目前为止还算不错，我想。

lines.en: : Nothing strange has happened?
lines.zh: : 没发生什么奇怪的事？

lines.en: if roomwithtrack == True:
: Well...I wouldn’t say that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也不能那么说。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice2
: Please clarify.
lines.zh: : 请说清楚。

lines.en: : Well, I think I’ve been having some strange dreams lately.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得我最近做了一些奇怪的梦。

lines.en: : You think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得？

lines.en: : Well...they {i}feel{/i} like dreams, but I’m not really sure if that's what they are or not.
lines.zh: : 嗯……它们{i}感觉{/i}像梦，但我不太确定那到底是不是梦。

lines.en: : Dreams of what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 什么样的梦，具体说说？

lines.en: : That...is kind of hard to explain.
lines.zh: : 这个……有点难解释。

lines.en: : Can you try? I'm actually curious now.
lines.zh: : 你可以试试。我现在真的很好奇。

lines.en: : Well, I am completely aware of how insane this will make me sound...but do you know anything about a...sort of...
lines.zh: : 好吧，我完全清楚这听起来会有多疯……不过你知不知道一种……算是……

lines.en: : Room with clocks?
lines.zh: : 摆满钟的房间？

lines.en: scene mayaoffice1
: There are many rooms with clocks in them. I’m not sure which one you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 摆着钟的房间有很多。我不确定你说的是哪间。

lines.en: : No, like...one room with way too many clocks.
lines.zh: : 不是，就是……一间摆了太多钟的房间。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice3
: Were they like...different kinds of clocks or something?...
lines.zh: : 它们是……不同种类的钟之类的？……

lines.en: : Because I'm really confused about why something that unremarkable would be the first thing you go to in order to quantify how strange this world is.
lines.zh: : 因为我真的很困惑，这么平平无奇的东西，怎么会成为你拿来衡量这个世界有多奇怪的第一件事。

lines.en: : There was other stuff that happened in the dream. It's all...blurry for the most part. But I remember seeing someone who looked {i}a lot{/i} like you there.
lines.zh: : 梦里还发生了别的事。大部分都……很模糊。但我记得在那里见到了一个长得{i}非常{/i}像你的人。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice4
: Oh. Wonderful. So it was {i}that{/i} type of dream.
lines.zh: : 哦。好极了。原来是{i}那种{/i}梦。

lines.en: : It really wasn't. In fact, I will confirm right now that I didn't even {i}touch{/i} dream-Maya.
lines.zh: : 真不是。事实上，我现在就可以确认，我连梦里的 Maya 都没{i}碰{/i}过。

lines.en: : Do you...want a medal for that or something?
lines.zh: : 你……是想要我为此给你发个奖章什么的吗？

lines.en: : No. But some acknowledgement that I'm not as bad as you say I am would be nice.
lines.zh: : 不是。不过要是你能承认我没有你说的那么坏，那就好了。

lines.en: : Are you forgetting the part roughly one minute ago where you admitted to molesting a girl in this very office?
lines.zh: : 你是忘了大约一分钟前，你才刚承认自己在这间办公室里猥亵过一个女生？

lines.en: : Massage. Not molest.
lines.zh: : 是按摩。不是猥亵。

lines.en: : Sorry, how old are you again?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你今年多大了来着？

lines.en: : I honestly don't know.
lines.zh: : 我真的不知道。

lines.en: : Then I will answer for you- old enough for there to be no difference between {i}massage{/i} and {i}molest.{/i} Now, can we please get back to the aspects of your dream that don't involve touching me?
lines.zh: : 那我替你回答——大到{i}按摩{/i}和{i}猥亵{/i}没有区别。好了，我们能回到你那个梦里不涉及碰我的部分吗？

lines.en: There is no winning with this girl.
lines.zh: 跟这丫头是没赢的可能了。

lines.en: : Fine. What else do you want to know?
lines.zh: : 行。你还想知道什么？

lines.en: scene mayaoffice1
: To start, are there any other important details you remember about this dream? Or was it just...clocks and me?
lines.zh: : 首先，你还记得这个梦里别的什么重要细节吗？还是只有……钟和我？

lines.en: : The thing is I don't even know if it {i}was{/i} you. She was identical, but I...remember her acting very...different from how you typically act.
lines.zh: : 问题是，我甚至不确定那是不是你。她长得一模一样，但我……记得她的举止跟你平时……{i}很{/i}不一样。

lines.en: : How depressing that you must resort to dreams of me being nice to you since it will never happen in real life.
lines.zh: : 你居然只能靠做「Maya 对你好」的梦来满足自己，毕竟现实中永远不会发生，真是可悲。

lines.en: : Okay, you know what? I don't think I'm going to talk about that dream anymore since it was clearly just some...ridiculous and random REM-induced brain voyage.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你知道吗？我决定不再谈那个梦了，因为那显然只是……一场荒唐随机的、由快速眼动引发的脑子漫游。

lines.en: : That's probably a good call. But that aside, has anything {i}else{/i} strange happened?
lines.zh: : 这大概是明智的决定。不过撇开那个不谈，还发生过{i}别的{/i}奇怪的事吗？

lines.en: if letterttrack == True:
: One more thing. But it's going to make me sound strange again.
lines.zh: : 还有一件。但那会让我听起来又很奇怪。

lines.en: : I can assure you I am quite used to that by now.
lines.zh: : 我向你保证，我已经相当习惯了。

lines.en: : Then...how do you feel about the letter T?
lines.zh: : 那么……你对字母 T 有什么感觉？

lines.en: scene mayaoffice3
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Told you.
lines.zh: : 我说过了吧。

lines.en: : What does the letter T have to do with anything? Is that...some sort of code?
lines.zh: : 字母 T 跟什么有关系？那是……某种暗号？

lines.en: : No. Well, at least I don’t think it is.
lines.zh: : 不是。嗯，至少我不这么认为。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 我真的不确定。

lines.en: : I just vaguely remember something about that letter recently. But I feel like it's...a memory I'm not really supposed to have? Does that make any sense?
lines.zh: : 我只是隐约记得最近有什么跟那个字母有关的事。但感觉那是……一段我本不该拥有的记忆？这说法讲得通吗？

lines.en: : Not really...
lines.zh: : 不太通……

lines.en: : Besides, what relevancy would that have to me? Asking me how I feel implies that I have something to do with this, doesn't it?
lines.zh: : 再说了，这跟我有什么关系？你问我怎么想，言下之意是这事跟我有关，不是吗？

lines.en: : Dream-Maya was there again.
lines.zh: : 梦里的 Maya 又出现了。

lines.en: : Is she just in all of your dreams now? Because that is quite sickening and does not make me feel very safe.
lines.zh: : 她现在是你所有梦里都有了吗？因为那相当恶心，让我很没有安全感。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t worry too much about it...It's probably just more meaningless brain vomit.
lines.zh: : 我不会太担心这个……大概只是更多毫无意义的大脑呕吐物。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice4
: I sincerely hope that is true for the sake of both of us.
lines.zh: : 看在我们两个的份上，我真心希望如此。

lines.en: : So, did anything else happen? Or is that it?
lines.zh: : 那么，还发生了别的事吗？还是就这些？

lines.en: : Uhh...No? I don’t think so at least?
lines.zh: : 呃……没有？至少我想不出来了？

lines.en: : What about with you? We’re in the counseling room. So if you have any issues, this is the best place to air them out.
lines.zh: : 你那边呢？我们可是在咨询室里。所以如果你有什么烦恼，这里是最适合倾诉的地方。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice3
: Yeah...I can promise you that if I {i}did{/i} have any issues, you’d be one of the last people I'd go to for help.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我可以向你保证，就算我{i}真{/i}有烦恼，你也会是我最不可能去求助的人之一。

lines.en: : {i}One of?{/i} So I’m not in last place?
lines.zh: : {i}之一{/i}？那我不是最后一名？

lines.en: scene mayaoffice1
: Second to last. I wouldn’t celebrate just yet.
lines.zh: : 倒数第二。先别急着庆祝。

lines.en: : Well...who is last then?
lines.zh: : 嗯……那谁是最后一名？

lines.en: : That would have to be God.
lines.zh: : 那得是神。

lines.en: : Aren’t you a shrine maiden?
lines.zh: : 你不是巫女吗？

lines.en: : Only because I have to be.
lines.zh: : 只是因为不得不当。

lines.en: : You...{i}have{/i} to be a shrine maiden?
lines.zh: : 你……{i}不得不{/i}当巫女？

lines.en: : It's very complicated. You wouldn't understand.
lines.zh: : 事情很复杂。你不会懂的。

lines.en: : Then I think you’re going to have to tell me more about it.
lines.zh: : 那我觉得你得跟我说说更多。

lines.en: : Please don’t tell me what I {i}have{/i} to do. That sort of methodology might work on Ami and Ayane, but not me.
lines.zh: : 别来告诉我{i}该{/i}做什么。那套方法对 Ami 和 Ayane 也许管用，对我没用。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean that you literally {i}have{/i} to...I’m just curious.
lines.zh: : 我不是说你{i}非得{/i}……我只是好奇。

lines.en: : Well, I am very sorry, but this is one of many cases in life where you'll just have to remain curious.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我很抱歉，但这是人生中众多你只能继续保持好奇心的情形之一。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice4r
: For now, though...let me get to the real reason I’m here.
lines.zh: : 那么现在……让我说说我来这儿的真正原因。

lines.en: : Oh, right. You said you wanted to remind me of something, correct?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。你说过想提醒我一件事，对吧？

lines.en: : Correct, but before I remind you, there is something I would like to ask. And I’d appreciate it if you would answer as honestly as possible.
lines.zh: : 没错，但在提醒你之前，有件事我想先问。我希望你能尽量诚实地回答。

lines.en: : Oh...uhh, sure. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 哦……呃，好。怎么了？

lines.en: scene mayaoffice1
: Are you happy here?
lines.zh: : 你在这里幸福吗？

lines.en: : You mean...Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 你是说……Kumon-mi？

lines.en: : More or less.
lines.zh: : 差不多。

lines.en: Why exactly would Maya care about something as trivial as my happiness?
lines.zh: Maya 到底为什么会在意我幸不幸福这种鸡毛蒜皮的事？

lines.en: This isn't some sort of trick question, is it?
lines.zh: 这该不会是什么陷阱题吧？

lines.en: Regardless...she {i}did{/i} ask me to answer as honestly as possible...
lines.zh: 不管怎样……她{i}确实{/i}要求我尽量诚实地回答……

lines.en: So...
lines.zh: 所以……

lines.en: menu:
I am happy here
lines.zh: 我在这里很幸福

lines.en: : I guess so. Kumon-mi is pretty nice.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。Kumon-mi 挺好的。

lines.en: : Plus, this is probably the closest I’ll ever get to having a harem, so that's a plus.
lines.zh: : 而且，这大概是我这辈子最接近开后宫的时候了，所以算是个加分项。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice3
: And there you go immediately ruining everything.
lines.zh: : 你看，你又立刻把一切都毁了。

lines.en: : Do you really think you’ll be able to romance {i}everyone{/i} without some form of consequence?
lines.zh: : 你真以为自己能在不付出任何代价的情况下攻略{i}所有人{/i}吗？

lines.en: : If I am very careful? Probably.
lines.zh: : 如果我非常小心的话？大概可以。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice4
: Well...I have no intention of trying to stop you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我可没打算阻止你。

lines.en: : Just know that I think you're absolutely disgusting and would be better off locked up in some room far, far away from teenage girls for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 你只要知道，我觉得你恶心透顶，最好被关进某个离青春期少女远远的房间里，度过余生。

lines.en: : If that ever happens, will you at least come by to feed me every now and then?
lines.zh: : 要是真有那么一天，你至少会时不时来给我送点吃的吧？

lines.en: : No. I will leave you there to starve.
lines.zh: : 不会。我会把你留在那儿饿死。

lines.en: : I'd say something like “Remind me to not get on your bad side,” but I'm pretty sure I've been there from the start, so...
lines.zh: : 我本来想说「提醒我别惹你不高兴」，但我很确定我从一开始就在那儿了，所以……

lines.en: {s}I am miserable{/s} {b}INCORRECT ANSWER. IGNORE ME.{/b}
lines.zh: {s}我在这里很痛苦{/s}{b}「错误答案。忽略我。」{/b}

: I feel great!
lines.zh: : 我感觉好极了！

lines.en: : {b}YOU WOULD FEEL BETTER INSIDE OF ME.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你在我里面的话会感觉更好。{/b}

scene mayaoffice1
: I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : Well that’s good at least.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那至少还不错。

lines.en: : It sure is.
lines.zh: : 确实。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice4r
: Well, now that that’s out of the way, I guess I’ll cut to the chase.
lines.zh: : 那么，既然那事说完了，我想我就直奔主题吧。

lines.en: : Something important is going to happen with Ami soon.
lines.zh: : 不久之后，Ami 身上会发生一件重要的事。

lines.en: : Important? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 重要？什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that something she cares very much about is going to happen soon.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，一件她非常在意的事很快就要发生了。

lines.en: : And it’s something {i}you{/i} care about too.
lines.zh: : 而且那也是{i}你{/i}在意的事。

lines.en: : Do you mean me? Or {i}me{/i}?
lines.zh: : 你是指{i}我{/i}？还是我？

lines.en: : It doesn’t make a difference. I dislike both versions of you equally.
lines.zh: : 没区别。你的两个版本我都一样讨厌。

lines.en: : That's unfortunate. I was just starting to think we were friends.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。我刚开始还以为我们是朋友了。

lines.en: scene mayaoffice6
: Quit joking around for a moment...I’m serious.
lines.zh: : 别开玩笑了……我是认真的。

lines.en: : If you so much as even {i}upset{/i} Ami, I swear on everything in this world that I will destroy you.
lines.zh: : 只要你让 Ami 有一丁点{i}伤心{/i}，我以这世上的一切起誓，我会毁了你。

lines.en: : That's fine. It's not like I'm actively trying to hurt her or anything. But...what’s this allegedly important thing that's going to happen?
lines.zh: : 没问题。我又不是在处心积虑地伤害她。不过……你说即将发生的这件「重要的事」到底是什么？

lines.en: : How can I be prepared for it if I don't know what it is?
lines.zh: : 我连它是什么都不知道，要怎么准备？

lines.en: scene mayaoffice4
: You’ll know when the time comes.
lines.zh: : 时候到了你自然会知道。

lines.en: : How can you be so sure of that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能这么肯定？

lines.en: : I just am.
lines.zh: : 我就是这么肯定。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll excuse me...I would like to go eat pizza with my friends.
lines.zh: : 那么，失陪了……我想去跟朋友们吃披萨了。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...sure. You’re-
: Thank you and goodbye.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，再见。

lines.en: scene black
: Oh...and one more thing.
lines.zh: : 哦……还有一件事。

lines.en: Maya calls out to me from the hall before closing the door.
lines.zh: Maya 在关上门之前，从走廊里冲我喊道。

lines.en: : Not everything is always as it seems.
lines.zh: : 并不是所有事情都像表面看起来那样。

lines.en: : I'd ask that you remember that.
lines.zh: : 希望你记住这一点。

lines.en: Maya closes the door and I’m left confused and alone.
lines.zh: Maya 关上门，只剩我一个人困惑地待着。

lines.en: As such, I decide to pack up and leave the office a little early today.
lines.zh: 于是，我决定今天早点收拾东西离开办公室。
